content_patterns: Imperative, task-focused microcopy: 'Align receipt within the frame'. Icon-led chrome (close, flash) with no other UI text; camera UI conventions throughout (shutter, thumbnail, AUTO mode). Minimal screen — controls only, no nav or headers.
notable_interactions: Full-screen camera view with document-scan overlay: blue corner brackets imply live edge detection of the receipt. X button implies dismiss/exit; flash icon implies torch toggle; 'AUTO' circle implies capture-mode cycling; large white shutter implies take-photo; bottom-left thumbnail implies access to previous captures/gallery. Faint grid in overlay suggests scanning/detection assist.
